profile.description: PZTestKit + the staged NutritionRevamp copy (release/plan11-x39, 513778e8), fixture two, admin and bob, Nutrition off, DayLength 1, gclog on - x391e, Plan 11b Task 2 session S2e.

meta.staging: python tools/release_pack.py stage mod/NutritionRevamp --out release/plan11-x39 at 513778e8 (Plan 11b Task 2); no instrument added
meta.seams_note: Every ghost run, in every loaded arm, runs the writer dry (W.dry) and skips the store step for ghost names (S.skip = H0.isGhost), set inside H0.work, which every scheduler calls (Plan 11a ruling 15).
meta.batching_note: burst times its 58 ghost runs in one batch at the minute event; mod keeps one batch open across a drain's contiguous ghost runs and closes it at a real player's run, a task or the drain's end (H0.modRun, H0.modWrap).
meta.cost_note: Every server reading is cost, not behaviour: the ghosts run copies of the real records against the two real IsoPlayers. The two real players stay on the mod's own drain.
meta.timer_note: getTimestampMs is 1 ms resolution: a frame's busy is a 1 ms reading; every per-run cost is a total over many runs divided by their count.
